_comment: Companion query lexicon for music.atproto.noizetoyz.synth.note — HappyView needs both the record lexicon and a paired query lexicon (this one, with target_collection pointing back at the record collection) registered to create the /xrpc/music.atproto.noizetoyz.synth.listNotes read endpoint. Modeled on the science.iosp.sensor.listReadings / run.saito.listFacts pairs already registered for stations 2/4 in this same HappyView instance.

main.description: Lists music.atproto.noizetoyz.synth.note records across the network, most recent first — read by landing-page/viewer.html and webapp/index.html's live feed.
